title: Identity without stored credentials
summary: Separate application identity, authorization and secret storage; choose a narrow role and scope.

identity.clue: An application hosted on a supported resource needs an automatically managed Entra credential instead of a stored password

role.clue: The association of a principal, permission definition and scope that grants access through RBAC

scope.clue: The boundary, such as one storage account, at which an access grant applies

vault.clue: The service for storing secrets, keys and certificates rather than embedding them in source code

least.clue: The security principle of granting only the permissions required for a task
